title: Phone catch-up is one current digest, not a replay of every update in order

requirements.text: When the phone app comes back with two or more unheard replies, it speaks one digest instead of each reply in order
requirements.check: manual: phone away 15 min with 3 updates -> one spoken digest

requirements.text: The digest drops or folds updates that are stale by now (a question since settled by a decision)
requirements.check: manual: a settled question is not read out

requirements.text: Every update is still in the conversation list to scroll back to
requirements.check: eye: replies listed under the digest

text: Planned only. TJ also asked (phone): pause other apps' music during readouts - built under T-HMHNF, not here.
Structured digest: replies come back as items tagged with project and task; the phone walks TJ through them one at a time, waiting for his response to each before moving on
user_said: I wanted to figure out that the responses come back in a structured format With project info task info so that when the app reads it back to me It has a digest of Objects that it's walking me through so I can respond to each before it moves on

text: No spoken progress mid-turn: the phone stays quiet until the reply is finished
user_said: I think it's fine To stay quiet until the reply is finished

evidence: Superseded by TJ's structured walk-through (decision 1): a single spoken digest is replaced by items read one at a time

text: Tally's replies to the phone carry structured items, each with project, task, a short spoken line and an optional question; a reply without them still reads as one item
check: test: bridge test parses a reply with a digest block into items, and a plain reply into one item

text: The phone walks the items one at a time: it speaks one, opens the mic, and waits for TJ's response before moving to the next
check: manual: a 3-item reply on the Pixel is read one item at a time, the next only after a response

text: TJ can answer, say next, repeat or stop on each item; answers reach Tally tagged with that item's project and task
check: test+manual: Tally's transcript shows each answer labelled with its project and task

text: Items not yet heard are folded: a newer item for the same project and task replaces the older one, and an item counts as heard only once it has been spoken, not when it was shown as a notification
check: manual: phone away, two updates on one task -> only the newer one is walked

text: Requirements rewritten to TJ's structured walk-through (items tagged project+task, one at a time, wait for response). Shape proposed to TJ; nothing built yet. Open: answers sent each at once or batched at the end.

Big structured batches in and out: nothing streams in or interrupts while a reply is read or answered; incoming merges into the phone's compiled list, outgoing answers go as one structured batch, to keep network traffic and agent spend down
user_said: getting messages While it's already getting a response or while it's already reading the response or while I'm giving a response that should be queued up and compiled together in a more intelligent way it shouldn't just be streamed in and streamed out and I don't want this to really increase the network traffic or the agent spend so realistically I want big batches to come in and out together... the phone needs to Compile organized ins and organized outs so that it knows If something else streams in it goes into that compiled list and it has to figure out how to handle that

text: Answers given during a walk are held and sent to Tally as one structured batch when the walk ends or is stopped, so one walk costs one Tally turn
check: test+manual: 3 answers -> one message to Tally listing all 3 with project and task; Tally's transcript shows one prompt

text: Items that arrive while a reply is read or while TJ is answering never interrupt or speak out of turn; they merge into the phone's compiled list by the agreed placement rule
check: test+manual: an item arriving mid-walk is not spoken until its place in the list, and lands where the rule says

text: TJ chose batch out, and widened it: nothing streams in or interrupts mid-walk; ins and outs are compiled batches. Reqs 8-9 added. Waiting on TJ to confirm the mid-walk placement rule before building.
Mid-walk placement rule accepted as proposed. Add a flush: send the answers given so far without finishing the walk; unheard items stay queued
user_said: Yeah I think all that makes sense ... we need a way to flush The answers ... I need a way to flush my responses in case I can't finish out

text: Flush: a 'Send N answers' button during the walk, and the spoken words 'send' / 'that's it' / 'stop'; all send the answers so far as one batch and end the walk, unheard items stay queued for next time. Held answers survive an app restart.
user_said: I need a way to flush my responses in case I can't finish out

text: TJ can flush mid-walk with an on-screen Send button or by saying send / that's it / stop: answers so far go as one batch, unheard items stay queued for the next walk
check: test+manual: answer 2 of 5, say send -> one batch of 2 reaches Tally; reopening shows 3 unheard

evidence: bridge npm test 28/28: items.test.mjs parses an items block into tagged items (m1-0 genlock/phone digest question) and a plain or broken reply into one item; e2e through local wrangler relay: reply.items reached the fake phone with the block cut from text
